d2_intro_1.speaker: Narration
d2_intro_1.text: Evening settles in. The phone buzzes — a friend, voice thin and shaking. They need someone, and they need them now.

d2_intro_2.speaker: Narration
d2_intro_2.text: June has been holding everyone together lately, and the weight of it shows. Still, someone has to answer.

d2_out_june.speaker: June
d2_out_june.text: "I'm here. Take all the time you need." She listens the way she always does, and slowly the friend's breathing steadies.

d2_out_iris.speaker: Iris
d2_out_iris.text: Calm and steady, if a little formal. It helps — though warmth would have helped more.

d2_out_rowan.speaker: Rowan
d2_out_rowan.text: He reaches for solutions before feelings — fix it, fast. The friend feels a little rushed, but not alone.

d2_done.speaker: Narration
d2_done.text: The call ends softer than it began. Some days, showing up is the whole of it. The day winds down.
